name: orc_biomass_chp
title: Biomass-boiler ORC (R123) with scroll expanders and a split condenser
summary: Organic Rankine cycle on R123 heated by a biomass boiler and coupled, through the feed-water loop, to a condenser split in two parts (water cooled then air cooled). The evaporator (liquid/two-phase/vapour zones), the scroll expander (5 machines in parallel, semi-empirical with leakage and wall heat transfer) and the biomass burner (adiabatic combustion, flue-gas and water-to-ambient heat exchangers) are component sub-models, written as EES MODULE/SUBPROGRAM blocks in the original and flattened into the main program here (decision D10): 73.2 kW net, first-law efficiency 0.108 (EES reference solution).

authors: S. Quoilin (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory) — probable, to be confirmed by the maintainer (EES licence stamp: Jean Lebrun lab licence, initials 'sylvain')

verification.notes: Blocked, not verified. coolsolve ./orc_biomass_chp.eescode -> "Parse failed: Line 479, 480, 481, 555, 556, 558: Could not parse line" (the C%/H%/O% variable names, CS-GAP-NAME-SYMBOL). With only those six names replaced, coolsolve -d reports Equations: 443, Variables: 432, System square: No, because the $if/$else directives are parsed and ignored (CS-GAP-IF-DIRECTIVE). The variable records decoded from the binary .EES are stale for the module-internal variables (CS-BUG-EXTRACT-STALE: P_r_su1_exp = 1.016e6 against P_r_su_exp = 1.461e6 and r_p_su_exp = 0.99997), so they were not used as reference and no .initials is shipped. EES reference values: eta_I 0.108, eta_global 0.88, W_dot_el_net 72320 W, Q_dot_ev 672320 W, Q_dot_cd 600000 W, Q_dot_u_boil 672301 W, epsilon_s_exp 0.828, M_dot_r_exp_tot 3.259 kg/s, n_exp 17.5, t_r_ex_exp 92.27 C, p_ev 1.461e6 Pa, p_cd 3.065e5 Pa. C-46 review: CS-GAP-LKT removed from missing_features (a write() into a missing lookup table parses and solves, SUCCESS in an 8-line model). The flattening dropped six formal-actual links (README, Known deviations) and the procedure cond header lost its :pinch_cd (restored). With the nine $if switches of the stored run resolved, the 24 numeric and 2 string diagram inputs of EES added and three links restored (scratch copy, not shipped) the system is square, 391 x 391, largest block 116; it does not converge from the decoded stored values.
